conventions.dates: ISO YYYY-MM-DD text; NULL when unknown (never substituted by receipt date)
conventions.codes: ICD-10-CM dotted upper case; LOINC with check digit; NDC 11-digit; NPI 10-digit Luhn
conventions.lineage: every mapped row keeps the source row identifier in record_id
conventions.approval: a mapping is applied only when approval.approved is true and only fields with accept: true

patient.meaning: One row per roster patient. age_reported/sex_reported as received; coverage_type/status from latest coverage record, else (population-feed members without one) coverage_type = line_of_business of the latest enrollment month and coverage_status active | inactive by whether a span covers the as-of date; coverage_source = coverage_record | enrollment_span (NULL = no coverage received). pcp_* = latest assigned primary-care relationship.

patient_id.description: Source patient identifier; prefer the source/human identifier over integer surrogates.

age_reported.description: Reported age at profile capture (not advanced).

coverage_type.description: Latest coverage record coverage_type (from the coverage entity).

coverage_status.description: Latest coverage record status (from the coverage entity).

coverage.grain: one row per received coverage / enrollment period record

patient_id.description: Patient the row belongs to (the source patient identifier, not a warehouse surrogate).

visit.meaning: One row per encounter (encounter records repeat once per status version; use visit, not encounter, to count visits). Latest version wins; versions = number of received versions.
visit.grain: one row per received encounter record (status versions repeat the encounter)

versioning.source: semantic_layer.build(): visit = row_number() over coalesce(encounter_id, record_id) order by (status='completed') desc, available_date desc, record_id desc

record_id.description: Unique identifier of the received source row (lineage; every semantic row keeps it). When the source has none, apply synthesizes <table>#<row number>.

encounter_id.description: Business encounter identifier shared by all versions of one encounter.

patient_id.description: Patient the row belongs to (the source patient identifier, not a warehouse surrogate).

type.description: Encounter type as received (office, telephone, emergency, inpatient, ...).

available_date.description: Date the row became available to the warehouse (receipt clock, not the clinical event clock).

organization_id.description: Organization / care site where the event happened.

versions.description: Number of received versions of the encounter.

condition.meaning: One row per (condition record, matching library concept); concept NULL when no library concept matches. Sources: conditions, condition_assessments, problem_lists. label = received description.
condition.grain: one row per received condition record

record_id.description: Unique identifier of the received source row (lineage; every semantic row keeps it). When the source has none, apply synthesizes <table>#<row number>.

patient_id.description: Patient the row belongs to (the source patient identifier, not a warehouse surrogate).

available_date.description: Date the row became available to the warehouse (receipt clock, not the clinical event clock).

organization_id.description: Organization / care site where the event happened.

concept.description: Agere concept from ICD-10 prefix / label (concepts.concept_for_code).

measurement.meaning: Labs and vitals, one row per (record, concept); concept NULL when unmapped. value/unit as received; value_canonical in unit_canonical when the unit converts (else NULL). Cancelled results have value NULL. concept egfr = BSA-normalised eGFR only (mL/min/1.73m2 or no unit); GFR results reported in another unit (mL/min, measured GFR / clearance) are concept gfr_unnormalized and never count as eGFR. Use only result_current = 1 AND excluded_reason IS NULL rows for values; value_censor marks censored strings (eGFR ">60" -> 60 with value_censor ">"); see measurement_quality. Questionnaire totals are measurements too: mood_questionnaires rows (source_table mood_questionnaires, one row per administration, name = instrument) carry concept phq9 (PHQ-9 total 0-27) or phq2 (PHQ-2 total 0-6), value = total in points; event_time orders same-day administrations.
measurement.grain: one row per received lab or vital result

record_id.description: Unique identifier of the received source row (lineage; every semantic row keeps it). When the source has none, apply synthesizes <table>#<row number>.

patient_id.description: Patient the row belongs to (the source patient identifier, not a warehouse surrogate).

available_date.description: Date the row became available to the warehouse (receipt clock, not the clinical event clock).

organization_id.description: Organization / care site where the event happened.

concept.description: Agere measurement concept (name pattern, then LOINC; concepts.MEASUREMENTS).

value_canonical.description: value converted to the concept canonical unit (concepts.MEASUREMENTS[c].units).

medication.meaning: Every medication mention, one row per (record, drug_class): source_stream and evidence (dispensed, claim, ordered, listed, administered, reported, pharmacy_history, payer_claim = payer pharmacy claim), drug_name as received, status. drug_class from the active ingredient (statin, beta_blocker, hf_evidence_based_beta_blocker, ace_inhibitor, arb, arni, mra, sglt2_inhibitor, glp1_agonist, metformin, insulin, anticoagulant, opioid, ...); NULL when unclassified. drug_class values are exact ids (full list and groups in drug_class_vocabulary): compare with = or IN, never LIKE - '%beta%' also matches short_acting_beta_agonist and '%antihistamine%' matches both generations. Use beta_blocker, first_generation_antihistamine (Beers), second_generation_antihistamine, short_acting_beta_agonist. picked_up = 1 on fills that left the pharmacy (evidence dispensed | claim | payer_claim with status dispensed | paid | completed, not reversed / returned to stock; prepared-only dispenses never count): use picked_up = 1 for any fill, pickup or dispensing count.
medication.grain: one row per received medication mention (order, dispense, claim, list, administration, report)

record_id.description: Unique identifier of the received source row (lineage; every semantic row keeps it). When the source has none, apply synthesizes <table>#<row number>.

patient_id.description: Patient the row belongs to (the source patient identifier, not a warehouse surrogate).

evidence.description: What kind of evidence the row is: dispensed, claim, ordered, listed, administered, reported, pharmacy_history, payer_claim.

available_date.description: Date the row became available to the warehouse (receipt clock, not the clinical event clock).

drug_class.description: Drug class from the active ingredient (drug_classes.classify).

claim.meaning: One row per medical claim_id (adjudications arrive as successive records: denied, paid, reversed, re-paid). first_status by arrival order; final_status follows the adjudication chain (each reversal paired with the payment it reverses; final = last unreversed adjudication by event time), received_final_status = last-arrival status, live_payer_paid_cents = payer paid on unreversed payments; denied_then_paid = a denial later followed by payment; net_payer_paid_cents = paid minus reversed. Legacy rows without claim_id are excluded. Provider-side claims only; payer-feed claims are in payer_claim.
claim.grain: one row per received claim adjudication record (denied, paid, reversed, re-paid)

versioning.source: semantic_layer._derived() claim aggregate + semantic_layer.settle_history() adjudication chain

record_id.description: Unique identifier of the received source row (lineage; every semantic row keeps it). When the source has none, apply synthesizes <table>#<row number>.

claim_id.description: Business claim identifier shared by every adjudication of the claim.

patient_id.description: Patient the row belongs to (the source patient identifier, not a warehouse surrogate).

payer_paid_cents.description: Amount the payer paid on this adjudication.

available_date.description: Date the row became available to the warehouse (receipt clock, not the clinical event clock).

reverses_record_id.description: For reversals, the record_id of the adjudication being reversed.

versions.description: Adjudication records received for the claim.

claim_line.meaning: One row per medical claim line: cpt or hcpcs (CPT/HCPCS service code), local_charge_code (the local charge code, kept across releases), revenue_code (UB-04 lines), units, charge_cents.
claim_line.grain: one row per received claim line

record_id.description: Unique identifier of the received source row (lineage; every semantic row keeps it). When the source has none, apply synthesizes <table>#<row number>.

patient_id.description: Patient the row belongs to (the source patient identifier, not a warehouse surrogate). Optional for lines: derived through claim_id when absent.

service_code.description: CPT or HCPCS code (split into cpt/hcpcs columns).

clinician.meaning: Clinician reference rows: specialty, synthetic npi, NUCC taxonomy_code, organization_id.

organization_id.description: Organization / care site where the event happened.

organization.meaning: Organization reference rows: organization_type, npi, taxonomy_code, tin, city/state/postal_code; facility_class (hospital, ambulatory_surgery_center, imaging_idtf, urgent_care, dialysis, skilled_nursing, home_health, hospice, ambulance, dme, pharmacy, laboratory, primary_care, outpatient_practice, payer, other) from the directory type; place_of_service = most frequent CMS POS on claims billed under the organization NPI (place_of_service_claims = n).
organization.grain: one row per organization / care site

stay.meaning: Distinct hospital stays (inpatient/observation encounters collapsed by admit day and overlap) with 30-day readmission flag. discharge_date and los_days are NULL when no discharge time was received (discharge_known = 0); never treat those as 0 days. discharge_date is the ADT discharge (A03) date of the stay's encounter when one was received (discharge_date_source = adt), else the date part of the encounter end_time (encounter_end_time_utc); discharge_time_utc keeps the UTC end timestamp. Readmission gaps use discharge_date. LOS uses one clock: admit_time_utc = UTC start of the admitting encounter; los_days = midnights between the UTC dates of admit_time_utc and discharge_time_utc, los_days_elapsed = fractional days between the two timestamps (state which one an answer uses); ADT/claims-only stays count local admit to local discharge dates. stay_source = encounters, or adt | payer_claim for admissions found only in ADT visits or inpatient (TOB 011x) / observation (revenue 0762) payer claims, so admission rates cover claims-only members; readmission flags of a patient with such stays are recomputed over all of the patient's stays.

concept_patient.meaning: Patients having each library concept (condition, measurement, encounter), with record counts and first/last dates.
concept_patient.derivation: Patients per library concept from condition/measurement/encounter rows.

measurement_latest.meaning: Latest DATED value per patient and measurement concept (undated rows never count as latest); same_day_values/same_day_min for same-date ties (HEDIS uses the lowest).
measurement_latest.derivation: Latest dated measurement per patient and concept.

current_record.meaning: Latest version of each business entity in versioned (snapshot) streams: stream, key_field, business_id, versions, payload of the latest version. Use it for current state (current balance, current claim status).
current_record.derivation: Latest version per business id in versioned streams (VERSIONED_STREAMS).

link.meaning: Every record-to-record reference (fields ending _record_id/_record_ids): record_id/stream of the referring record, field name, target_record_id. Indexed on target_record_id - use it for linkage questions (e.g. orders without dispenses).

note_fact.meaning: Facts found only in free text (EF, symptoms, edema, dyspnea, medication non-adherence and reasons, social needs, imaging findings, follow-up instructions, goals of care, smoking status) in notes, documents and HIE ED/discharge summaries, with negation, temporality and evidence spans; copied-forward note lines count once per patient; rule extractor admitted per fact type at >= 0.90 measured precision.
note_fact.derivation: Facts extracted from free text by the note-fact rules.

social_need.meaning: Social-needs screening answers normalised across instruments: one row per (screen record, need) with positive 0/1. need = food | transport | cost_of_care, plus housing | utilities | safety from AHC HRSN screens (instrument AHC_HRSN; positive when any item for the need is answered yes; source_field = items:<item names>). transport positive = transport_difficulty_reported or transport unreliable (family_ride/reliable = negative); cost_of_care = difficulty paying for care (social screen) or medical bills (financial screen). Screened = has a row for that need.
social_need.derivation: Normalised social-needs answers from social/financial screens.

appointment.meaning: One row per appointment_id (appointments arrive as a booked record plus later status records). scheduled_date from the latest version carrying a scheduled_date (a reschedule moves it), else the date of slot_start (population-feed bookings send booked_at + slot_start); booked_date = earliest booked version; lead_time_days = scheduled_date - booked_date, NULL when either is unknown. final_status = latest status received; ever_* flags over all versions; kept = any arrived, attended or fulfilled version. outcome = kept | no_show (never kept) | cancelled (never kept or no-show) | rescheduled | scheduled (still booked) | unassigned (unassigned_requires_review) | unknown. No-show rate = no_show / (kept + no_show), or with cancelled in the denominator - state which.
appointment.derivation: Appointment entity from booked + status records (not yet an onboarding target).

claim_adjustment.meaning: One row per adjustment line on each medical claim adjudication record: group_code (CO/PR/OA), reason_code (X12 CARC), category (deductible, coinsurance, copay, contractual_adjustment, else group-code), amount_cents; current_version = 1 on the claim's latest version.
claim_adjustment.derivation: X12 CARC adjustment lines (not yet an onboarding target; needs 835 adjustment segments).

encounter.meaning: Encounter records plus ADT notifications (source_table adt, type = ADT event). type_concept = library encounter concept. ED visits that only ADT messages or payer claims carry (claims-only members) are added once each, deduplicated against the EHR (source_table adt_messages | payer_medical_claims, type_concept emergency_visit); see utilization_event.
encounter.derivation: Encounter + ADT rows (visit is the onboarding target).

encounter_diagnosis.meaning: ICD-10-CM diagnoses coded on encounters: one row per (encounter_id, rank, icd10, type); type principal/primary/secondary. Administrative contacts are uncoded by design.
encounter_diagnosis.derivation: Encounter-coded ICD-10 diagnoses (not yet an onboarding target).

immunization.meaning: One row per immunization record: vaccine, product, cvx, mvx, status (administration_status).
immunization.derivation: Immunization rows (not yet an onboarding target).

record.meaning: Every received record (all streams). Use json_extract(payload, '$.field') for fields of streams not modelled above.
record.derivation: Every received record (the onboarding lineage table plays this role).
